This week’s sales are concentrated in a few product×channel pairs (paid social + search); Play Scratch Lounge on ig_feed was the single largest contributor this week (₹18,553, 8 orders), while paid channels (ig_feed / fb_feed / google_search) supplied most of the ad spend against those products — several product sales sit in exchange_replacement / unattributed with no ad spend.

- Top contributors this week (2026-10-12..14): Play Scratch Lounge — ig_feed: net revenue ₹18,553 · orders 8 · ad spend ₹4,604; Pawveralls Suspender Boots — exchange_replacement: ₹12,707 · 7 orders · no ad spend; Pawveralls Pro Suspender Boots — exchange_replacement: ₹8,894 · 4 orders · no ad spend. (Full top rows truncated in the query; more available on request.)
- Largest paid-ad exposures: several high-revenue items on ig_feed and fb_feed also have material ad spend (e.g. SnugSole Boots ig_feed: ₹4,743 net revenue with ₹4,871 ad spend; SmartSip Fountain fb_feed: ₹4,024 with ₹2,016 ad spend), showing low net ROAS on those lines this week.
